name: net-retry
description: Automatically retries commands that failed because of a temporary network error.

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: How many times to run a command again after a temporary network error (0 turns the mod off).

backoffSeconds.title: First wait (seconds)
backoffSeconds.description: How long to wait before the first retry; each further retry waits twice as long. Waits count against the hook's 10-second budget, so long ones mean fewer retries.
